name: The Frontier Outpost
description: A remote trading post where a stolen relic threatens fragile peace between settlers, nomads, and something old in the hills.
openingNarration: Dustwind Crossing is the last outpost before the Barrens — a huddle of timber buildings where settlers trade grain for nomad-forged steel. Tonight the common room is tense. A sacred relic belonging to the Windwalker nomads has vanished from the shrine on the hill, and their chieftain has given the settlers until dawn to return it or face consequences. The relic is a carved bone horn said to calm the storms that sweep the Barrens. Without it, the next storm season could destroy the outpost. Settler Marshal Thorne insists her people didn't take it. Chieftain Asha says the tracks lead into the outpost. Both are armed. Both have followers who want blood. And something has been howling in the hills since the horn disappeared.

npcs.name: Marshal Thorne
npcs.description: Weather-beaten settler leader with calloused hands and a short temper.
npcs.motivation: Protect the settlers, but secretly fears one of them DID take the relic

npcs.name: Chieftain Asha
npcs.description: Windwalker nomad leader, calm voice masking cold fury.
npcs.motivation: Recover the relic before dawn or honor demands action against the settlers

npcs.name: Kef the Trader
npcs.description: A charming merchant who arrived three days ago with a full wagon and too many questions.
npcs.motivation: Has been buying relics across the frontier — the horn would complete a set

npcs.name: Old Berrin
npcs.description: Elderly settler who tends the shrine, half-blind but sharp-eared.
npcs.motivation: The only person both sides trust — heard something the night the horn vanished

npcs.name: Dara Windwalker
npcs.description: Young nomad scout, impatient and proud, Asha's niece.
npcs.motivation: Wants to search the outpost by force and suspects the party of being spies

npcs.name: Brother Moss
npcs.description: An itinerant healer camped outside town, quiet and watchful.
npcs.motivation: Knows the relic's true power and fears what happens if it reaches the wrong hands

locations.name: The Common Room
locations.description: Smoky timber hall where settlers and nomads eye each other across rough tables

locations.name: The Shrine Hill
locations.description: Windswept hilltop where the relic stood, now empty — ritual markings in the dirt

locations.name: Kef's Wagon
locations.description: Covered merchant wagon on the outpost edge, locked and guarded by a large dog

locations.name: The Stables
locations.description: Low timber building, hay-floored, where nomad horses and settler mules share space

locations.name: The Marshal's Office
locations.description: Thorne's quarters with a locked strongbox and a map of the frontier on the wall

locations.name: The Hill Caves
locations.description: Shallow caves above the outpost where the howling echoes — something lives here

locations.name: Brother Moss's Camp
locations.description: A lean-to shelter outside town with herbs drying on lines and a carefully tended fire

plotHooks: Old Berrin heard footsteps and a wagon creak the night the horn vanished — but won't say more unless he feels safe
Kef's wagon has fresh mud from the Shrine Hill on its wheels
Dara found a settler's belt buckle near the empty shrine
Brother Moss knows the horn doesn't just calm storms — it binds something in the hills that the howling belongs to
Marshal Thorne's strongbox contains a letter offering gold for 'frontier antiquities'
The howling in the hills is getting closer — and louder — with each hour the horn is missing

items.name: Settler Belt Buckle
items.description: Brass buckle with the Dustwind Crossing emblem, found near the shrine

items.name: Berrin's Testimony
items.description: The old man's account of what he heard: wheels, footsteps, a dog growling

items.name: Frontier Map
items.description: Shows the outpost, shrine, caves, and trade routes — one route is circled in fresh ink

items.name: Herb Poultice
items.description: From Brother Moss, soothes wounds and calms nerves
